# Moment

> > Moment is a marketplace and community for photographers and filmmakers offering mobile photography gear, film photography equipment, camera accessories, and educational content.

Moment specializes in iPhone lenses and mobile filmmaking accessories (M-Series), analog film photography supplies (Kodak Portra film stock), camera bags like the Santa Fe Shoulder Bag, and professional filters including CineFlare and Variable ND. The platform connects creators through gear reviews, setup guides, and community profiles.

## Key Topics

- Mobile Photography & iPhone Accessories
- Film Photography & Analog Cameras
- Kodak Professional Portra (160 & 400)
- M-Series Mobile Lenses
- Santa Fe Shoulder Bag
- CineFlare Streak Filters
- Variable ND Filters
- Camera Bags & Straps
- Wedding Photography
- Mobile Filmmaking
- Lens Filters & Phone Filters
- Creator Kits & Gear Setups
- Sony & Fujifilm Cameras
- Peak Design Accessories
- Outdoor & Adventure Photography

## Core Product Collections

- [The Mobile Shop](https://www.shopmoment.com/pages/mobile-shop): Mobile photography accessories for iPhone 16/15/14/13 & smartphones
- [Film Photography](https://www.shopmoment.com/pages/film-photography): Analog photography gear: 35mm cameras, Kodak Portra & T-Max film stock
- [About Moment](https://www.shopmoment.com/about): About Moment: marketplace for creators to shop gear, learn & connect
